authentication: All routes require a verified Supabase Google/Apple session; no guest/anonymous path. NestJS derives userId from verified claims. Mobile JSON must not select userId or correctness.

routes.returns: Only published whole chapters; unit title/goal, prerequisites and unlocked/locked/completed status derived from own exact-revision completion. No writes.

PublicUnit allowlist from pinned active revision, otherwise latest published accessible revision. GET never starts or updates progress. Scenario projection exposes only current/start node, no branch destinations or correctness.
Own active pinned Progress, existing completion for the same latest revision, or a newly started latest revision after prerequisites. Transaction/uniqueness makes retries idempotent.
Own Progress, or null when no progress exists. Unknown/inaccessible unit is404. No writes.
AttemptResult from src/progress.ts; meaningful feedback plus authoritative Progress. HTTP200 for valid submissions/replays, including retry feedback for incorrect answers.

attempt_response_kinds.continue: View acknowledgement for entry/vocabulary/explanation/dialogue/summary, not proof of comprehension.
attempt_response_kinds.arrange: Ordered tileIds containing each available tile exactly once. Missing, duplicate or unknown IDs return400; wrong order stays in place and marks corrective assistance. Answer order and feedback remain private until submission. Pre-submit editing/shuffling is local UI state, not an attempt.
attempt_response_kinds.scenario_choice: Current nodeId and choiceId; server decides next node or retry.
attempt_response_kinds.scenario_translation: Current nodeId of a spoken scenario line; returns its Hebrew translation as assistance (revealed.translationHe), stays on the node and does not advance. Refused when the node has no translation.
attempt_response_kinds.self_comparison: compared=true and mode=recording|without_microphone; no pronunciation judgment.
attempt_response_kinds.written_hint: Allowed written expression; stays in place and marks assistance.
attempt_response_kinds.help: Allowed helpId; stays in place and marks assistance.
attempt_response_kinds.skip: Only non-required activities; cannot bypass mandatory content.

errors.400: Malformed body, unsupported response kind for activity, unknown activity/choice/help, or skipping required activity.
errors.401: Missing, invalid, expired or unsupported login session. Refresh/re-authenticate securely, then retry original pending attempt.
errors.404: Unavailable unit, unmet prerequisites or progress not owned by verified user; do not disclose another user.
errors.409: Pinned revision/current activity/node/progress version changed, or same requestId with different canonical body. Reload authoritative progress before asking for a new response.
errors.503: Transient server/data-provider failure; retain pending request and do not advance.

idempotency.fingerprint: SHA256 of canonical JSON including path unitId and validated full request body, excluding tokens. Object key order does not change fingerprint.
idempotency.replay: Look up existing request before checking old expectedProgressVersion; return the originally stored result without advancing. Client must not regress to an older response snapshot: retain the higher progressVersion for the same revision or reload GET progress.
idempotency.atomicity: Attempt insertion and progress update occur together. A different requestId with stale progress version conflicts, even if it contains a correct answer.
idempotency.local_reference: applyAttempt is pure and checks these rules locally. It is not a database, concurrent server or authentication system.

network.policy: Wait for save acknowledgement; replay/reading remain available but no next activity.
network.pending_shape: PendingSubmissionSchema: userId, unitId, request; no token/audio/keys. The05 mobile storage adapter is not implemented in03.
network.restart: Restore only for the same authenticated user, resend unchanged requestId/body, then apply authoritative progress. On explicit sign-out clear pending data.
network.conflict: Reload progress and discard/reconcile obsolete pending request; never change its body while preserving requestId.

example.notice: Synthetic contract example for the real reviewed Hola question. Unit1A remains unpublished. No real request or save occurred.
example.phone_to_server: Send pending attempt with securely managed Bearer session.
example.server_to_database: Verify identity and immutable content; execute short atomic validation/save operation.
example.database_to_phone: Commit attempt and progress together, then return feedback/current position. Lost HTTP response is resolved by same requestId replay.

future_acceptance_tests_04_05: Real JWT validation including expiry, anonymous and invalid issuer rejection.
Google and Apple paths/cancellation on owned iPhone build.
Direct anon/authenticated writes and raw answer-key reads denied; own reads allowed, other-user reads denied.
Service RPC EXECUTE grants and explicit ownership checks verified, including service-role RLS bypass behavior.
Parallel duplicate submissions and distinct stale submissions cannot double-advance.
Injected database failure rolls back both attempt and progress.
Concurrent starts create one active progress record; pinned revisions remain loadable.
Publish/import failure never exposes a partial chapter; prior whole release remains active.
Actual app restart after response loss restores and retries the same pending attempt; sign-out cannot expose another user's queue.
limits: No routes, JWT guard, migrations, durable queue, cloud data, mobile UI, native build, media production or pronunciation assessment implemented by these local contracts.

scenario_node_representation.contextHe: Visible Hebrew event/action context; separate from speech translation.
scenario_node_representation.promptHe: Learner action prompt. Required for nonterminal nonverbal choice nodes.
scenario_node_representation.speech: textEs, translationHe and audioAssetId are either all present or all null. Nonverbal nodes require contextHe. Existing spoken-only nodes remain valid.
scenario_node_representation.playback: Play only non-null audioAssetId. A gesture or outcome does not fabricate Spanish speech or require a recording.
scenario_node_representation.projection: Only the requested current node and its choices are public; branch destinations, outcomes, feedback and reviews remain private. Choices carry only textEs (no Hebrew labels), and a spoken line's translationHe is withheld until a scenario_translation request is recorded as help.
scenario_node_representation.progression: Both accepted and declined seat preferences advance. Resume preserves scenarioNodeId and usedHelpForCurrent. Completion reveals the final context before moving to recap; it does not skip review/summary.
